protein_identifier.protein_name: Segment polarity protein dishevelled homolog DVL-2

domains_and_motifs.name: DIX domain
domains_and_motifs.description: Dishevelled and Axin domain. Mediates homo- and hetero-oligomerization with other DIX domain-containing proteins (DVL1, DVL3, AXIN1, AXIN2). Critical for both canonical and non-canonical Wnt signaling. Forms dynamic head-to-tail polymers that are important for Wnt signaling transduction.

domains_and_motifs.name: PDZ domain
domains_and_motifs.description: PDZ domain (Post synaptic density protein, Drosophila disc large tumor suppressor, and Zonula occludens-1 protein). Mediates binding to Frizzled receptors (FZD) via the KTxxxW motif, WGEF internal peptide motif, and VANGL2 peptides. Critical for canonical Wnt pathway activation and protein-protein interactions.

sources.notes: Crystal structure of DVL2 PDZ domain in complex with inhibitory peptide, 1.50 Å resolution
Crystal structure of DVL2 PDZ domain with WGEF peptide motif, 3.0 Å resolution

domains_and_motifs.name: Nuclear localization signal
domains_and_motifs.description: Conserved nuclear localization signal (Ile-X-Leu-Thr motif) located after the PDZ domain. Enables DVL2 nuclear translocation for interaction with beta-catenin-TCF transcriptional complexes.

sources.notes: Conserved NLS motif identified in DVL proteins

domains_and_motifs.name: DEP domain
domains_and_motifs.description: Dishevelled, Egl-10, and Pleckstrin domain. Required for Wnt-beta-catenin signaling in mammalian cells. Binds phosphatidic acid and mediates membrane localization. Important for both canonical and non-canonical (PCP) Wnt pathways.

domains_and_motifs.name: PGXPP degron motif
domains_and_motifs.description: Degron motif (PGAPP in DVL2, variant of PGGPP consensus) that mediates binding to KLHL12 E3 ligase for ubiquitination and degradation. The second glycine is substituted with alanine in DVL2/DVL3 compared to DVL1.

sources.notes: Identification of PGXPP degron motif in dishevelled, Open Biology 2020

domains_and_motifs.name: PY motif
domains_and_motifs.description: Proline-rich PY motif (PPXY) in C-terminus. Mediates binding to WW domain-containing proteins including WWP1 E3 ligase and USP9X deubiquitinase. Critical for regulating DVL2 ubiquitination status.

sources.notes: USP9X deubiquitylates DVL2 to regulate WNT pathway specification

domains_and_motifs.name: Proline-rich C-terminal region
domains_and_motifs.description: Intrinsically disordered proline-rich C-terminal region. Contains multiple phosphorylation sites for CK1epsilon, CK2, MARK kinases. Important for protein-protein interactions and regulation of DVL2 activity and localization. Contains PY motif and PGXPP degron.

sources.notes: ~15% of DVL2 sequence consists of S/T/Y residues that can be phosphorylated

alphafold_prediction.confidence_summary: High confidence for DIX, PDZ, and DEP structured domains. Low confidence for intrinsically disordered regions including N-terminus and C-terminal proline-rich region.

post_translational_modifications.function: Activating - CK1epsilon-mediated phosphorylation at Thr224 promotes canonical Wnt signaling

Regulatory - Over 50 phosphorylation sites identified across the protein, particularly in central region and C-terminus. Phosphorylation by CK1epsilon, CK2, MARK2, CSNK1D regulates DVL2 activity, localization, and pathway specification
Degradation - KLHL12-mediated polyubiquitination targets DVL2 for proteasomal degradation
Stabilizing/Regulatory - WWP1-mediated K27-linked ubiquitination stabilizes DVL2 and regulates pathway choice. USP9X deubiquitinase reverses WWP1 ubiquitination

function.uniprot_function: Mediates the Wnt signaling pathway. Participates both in the canonical and non-canonical Wnt signaling pathways by binding to the cytoplasmic C-terminus of frizzled family members (FZD) and transducing the Wnt signal to downstream effectors. Involved in the signal transduction pathways mediated by multiple Wnt genes. Plays a role in the planar cell polarity (PCP) pathway, regulating convergent extension movements and neural tube closure. Functions as a cytoplasmic adaptor protein that promotes beta-catenin stabilization and TCF/LEF-dependent transcriptional activation in canonical Wnt signaling.
function.catalytic_activity: Not applicable - DVL2 is an adaptor/scaffold protein, not an enzyme
function.tissue_specificity: Low tissue specificity - broadly expressed across many tissues including brain, heart, lung, kidney, skeletal muscle. Ubiquitous cytoplasmic expression with no strong tissue enrichment.

reactome.pathway_name: TCF dependent signaling in response to WNT
Disassembly of the destruction complex and recruitment of AXIN to the membrane
Negative regulation of TCF-dependent signaling by DVL-interacting proteins

pathways.pathway_role_summary: DVL2 is a central cytoplasmic adaptor protein in Wnt signaling pathways. Upon Wnt ligand binding to Frizzled receptors, DVL2 is recruited to the membrane, becomes phosphorylated by CK1epsilon/CK2/MARK kinases, and undergoes DIX-dependent polymerization. DVL2 recruits the destruction complex component AXIN to the membrane, leading to disassembly of the complex and beta-catenin stabilization (canonical Wnt). DVL2 also translocates to the nucleus to stabilize beta-catenin-TCF transcriptional complexes. In non-canonical Wnt-PCP signaling, DVL2 activates WGEF and interacts with VANGL2 to regulate planar cell polarity. DVL2 protein levels and pathway specification are regulated by the USP9X-WWP1 ubiquitin rheostat and KLHL12-mediated degradation.

disease_associations.description: DVL2 is overexpressed in colorectal adenomas and carcinomas in parallel with nuclear beta-catenin. Mouse models show DVL2 promotes intestinal length and neoplasia in ApcMin colorectal cancer model. DVL2 facilitates coordination of NF-kB and Wnt signaling to promote colitis-associated colorectal cancer progression. Not frequently mutated but acts as tumor promoter through overexpression.
Dishevelled 2 signaling promotes self-renewal and tumorigenicity in human gliomas through Wnt pathway activation.
PRICKLE3-USP9X-mediated DVL2 deubiquitination and stabilization promotes NSCLC progression via canonical Wnt pathway.
WWP1-mediated K27-linked ubiquitination of DVL2 regulates cardiac hypertrophy induced by pressure overload.

metadata.data_quality_notes: Comprehensive data available for DVL2. UniProt accession O14641 confirmed. Extensive structural data from PDB (DIX filament, PDZ domain complexes). Over 50 phosphorylation sites identified but specific residue numbers not fully mapped. Kinetic parameters available for CK1epsilon phosphorylation (kcat/Km ratios) but absolute values for individual rate constants not found. Interaction with APC is indirect via competitive AXIN binding. Most interactions have experimental evidence from multiple databases. Disease associations primarily involve overexpression rather than coding mutations. NLS sequence position approximate based on conserved motif description.
metadata.modeling_relevance_summary: DVL2 is critical hub protein in Wnt signaling network. Key features for modeling: (1) DIX domain-mediated dynamic polymerization with AXIN1/2 creates local concentration effects; (2) Multiple phosphorylation sites regulate activity, localization, and pathway choice (canonical vs PCP); (3) Ubiquitination rheostat (WWP1 vs USP9X vs KLHL12) controls protein stability and pathway specification; (4) PDZ domain mediates multiple specific interactions with different binding modes (C-terminal vs internal peptides); (5) Membrane recruitment via FZD binding is regulated event requiring phosphorylation; (6) Nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling adds spatial complexity. Available kinetic data for CK1epsilon provides starting point for phosphorylation dynamics modeling. Low-affinity AXIN interaction enhanced by DIX polymerization suggests avidity-based regulation.
